body.label: Effect
body.html: Choose yourself or one willing ally within 5 units. Teleport the target up to 3 units to a visible empty space.

surges.html: The teleported target may end one magical effect currently restricting its movement or position, if that effect is Rank 1 or lower.
One affected ally gains +1 Movement until the start of your next turn.

rider.title: SPACE THREAD
rider.html: After resolving this Action, create a Thread. Consume this Thread before resolving a future Magecraft Action that teleports or moves a creature to increase that distance by 1 unit.
